title: The Nod — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy Spanish French language learning social
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The nod is a form of communication between men in particular
That conveys everything necessary in the most perpendicular
To language way available — one downward tilt of the head
Means hello, acknowledgement, respect, and how've you been said

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El gesto de cabeza es una forma de comunicación entre hombres
[The nod is a form of communication between men]
Que transmite todo lo necesario sin usar sus nombres
[That conveys everything necessary without using their names]
Un gesto hacia abajo significa hola, reconocimiento, respeto
[A downward tilt means hello, acknowledgment, respect]
El gesto lo dice todo sin protocolo ni decreto
[The nod says everything without protocol or decree]

[Chorus — English]
The nod knows something I don't know
It knows the shortest distance between two men and the show
The nod carries the information without the words
It says I see you and that's sufficient — say the birds
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Le hochement de tête est une communication entre hommes
[The nod is a form of communication between men]
Qui dit tout le nécessaire sans les syllabes, les sommes
[That says everything necessary without syllables or sums]
Une inclinaison vers le bas signifie bonjour, respect, accord
[A downward tilt means hello, respect, agreement]
Le hochement sait tout ce qu'une conversation pourrait accorder
[The nod knows everything a conversation could grant]

[Outro — All three languages]
The nod knows… El gesto sabe… Le hochement sait
I see you — Te veo — Je te vois
That's my boy
